scope: Explicit Core safety BFS. Success means empty queue. Bounded runs stopped at --max-states; timings do not establish whole-model throughput.
hardware: Dedicated EC2 c8g.48xlarge, 192 physical Graviton4 cores, Ubuntu 24.04, taskset 0 through workers-1, sequential fresh processes, no swap.
common_build: Native Rust 1.99.0, cargo build --release --locked -p dive-cli with LTO=false and 16 codegen units. All variants include the fix to parallel commit time reporting.
command: dive check MODULE --config CFG --library-path modules --workers W --compat=tlc --fp 0 --seed 0 --max-memory 96g --time-limit T --output json. Supply --max-states CAP for bounded cases.

models.two: Flint author L1 control, with only MaxBarriers increased from 1 to 2; complete

variants.base: Scoped OS threads per ordinary safety batch; coordinator interns worker rows
variants.pool: For ordinary searches with at least 32 workers, use the existing scoped Rayon pool across batches
variants.rows: Default worker policy; enqueue already canonical resident local worker values directly

wide_membership_and_workers.platform: Dedicated EC2 c8g.24xlarge, 96 physical Graviton4 cores. One process at a time, pinned to CPUs 0..workers-1. Linux 7.0.0-1018-aws
wide_membership_and_workers.build: Native Rust 1.99.0, cargo build --release --locked -p dive-cli with LTO=false and 16 codegen units. All variants include the fix to parallel commit time reporting.
wide_membership_and_workers.models: Same CFGs as models above; SlateDB one-value prefix here uses 50,000,000 distinct. Two-barrier Flint is exhaustive. Other runs stop at their state cap. All use --compat=tlc --fp 0 --seed 0 --max-memory 100g --time-limit 1200s.

variants.rows: Retained canonical rows; ordinary thread scheduling.
variants.hit: rows plus a local resident fingerprint hit survives until ordered commit.
variants.poolhit: hit plus experimental Rayon worker-pool reuse at 32 or more workers.

wide_membership_and_workers.allocator: default uses the installed binary allocator. arena32 additionally sets MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=32. mimalloc additionally preloads the system libmimalloc. All three binaries use the same Rust global mimalloc allocator; these process environment arms do not replace it.

static_worker_binding.platform: Dedicated EC2 c8g.24xlarge, 96 physical Graviton4 cores. One process at a time, pinned to CPUs 0..workers-1. Linux 7.0.0-1018-aws
static_worker_binding.build: Native Rust 1.99.0, cargo build --release --locked -p dive-cli with LTO=false and 16 codegen units. All variants include the fix to parallel commit time reporting.
static_worker_binding.configurations: Same four named configurations, bounds and command flags as wide_membership_and_workers. 96 workers, two fresh processes per setting, no allocator environment overrides. All terminal observables match the earlier panel.

variants.hit: rows plus a local resident fingerprint hit survives until ordered commit.
variants.poolhit: hit plus experimental Rayon worker-pool reuse at 32 or more workers.
variants.bound: Assign each machine to the same Rayon worker by thread index for the search lifetime. Workers use the process-wide affinity mask; this does not pin them to individual physical cores.
variants.levelbound: Same worker assignment but replace the team at the next BFS level.

packed_frontier_reclamation.hardware: Dedicated c7i.8xlarge, Xeon Platinum 8488C, 16 physical cores pinned 0–15. Each timed process ran alone. Linux AWS, release build with debuginfo=1, LTO disabled, 16 codegen units. GNU time wall and peak RSS.
packed_frontier_reclamation.inputs: Flint LeanP1. Use the archived three-writer CFG in 2026-11-21-flint-leanp1.json. Two-barrier uses the small three-writer published control with only MaxBarriers raised to 2.
packed_frontier_reclamation.command: dive check LeanP1.tla --config CFG --workers 16 --compat=tlc --fp 0 --seed 0 --max-memory 45g --output json [--store-compact-bytes 0 | 17179869184] [--max-states CAP]. External wall limits 1800s for small series and 2150s for 100M. Two-barrier runs exhaust the graph; three-force/high use 35M; full-default uses 3M. 100m-default uses 100M.
packed_frontier_reclamation.cpu_samples: Separate forced-collection two-barrier runs sampled at 97 Hz with Linux perf (cpu-clock). Remap::copy had 0.48% baseline and 0.05% candidate self samples across all workers; packed block encode 0.10% in both, append 0.08% / 0.06%. Process-wide samples do not isolate the serial wall time.
packed_frontier_reclamation.controls: Eight Core retention tests, focused Store tests and four forced-collection invariant-violation trials at one and 16 workers. Real words passed independent replay and a corrupted final step failed. Fresh independent execution checked 5,376 fields with hash-consing on/off, raw/normalized aliases, stale roots, changing columns, stop/retry, width errors, genuine and altered words.

default_store_growth.scope: 1 run per arm, measured state-limited prefixes on dedicated c7i.8xlarge nodes (us-east-2). Sixteen workers pinned to CPUs 0-15, release binary with debug info, seed/fp 0, TLC profile, 45 GiB checker budget; default fingerprint membership. Separate nodes for the Flint and three-model panels. No decision on full-model speed from these prefixes.
default_store_growth.change: The 256 MiB automatic Store threshold is initially absolute. After a successful collection, charge 256 MiB of new measured retained bytes above the actual post-copy live size. Explicit byte thresholds and zero retain their previous behavior.
default_store_growth.commands: dive check MODULE --config CFG --library-path MODULES --workers 16 --compat=tlc --seed 0 --fp 0 --max-memory 45g --max-states LIMIT --time-limit 1600s --output json. Flint used 2650s. GNU time elapsed seconds and max RSS in KiB.
default_store_growth.flint_100m_control: See packed_frontier_reclamation for the shipped 512.60-second, 6,136,408 KiB 100M default control on the same host.
